task.title: Materialize one exact persisted recurrence occurrence atomically
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/889 by binding one revision-observed persisted occurrence to one caller-owned inert task without partial durable state.
acceptance_criteria: Require an exact persisted recurrence coordinate, observed occurrence revision, and caller-owned task identity while deriving the task goal from immutable recurrence provenance.
Atomically append the occurrence materialization and task start while rejecting missing, stale, duplicate, replacement, and task collision requests with typed evidence.
Replay persisted-to-materialized histories strictly, preserve existing occurrence views, and grant no due, catch-up, dispatch, or execution authority.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused recurrence-store test failed because materialize_occurrence, materialized lookup, and typed materialization errors did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added success, reopen, exact goal provenance, missing and stale occurrence, duplicate binding, task collision, concurrent materialization, atomicity, and malformed-history tests.

attempts.summary: Implemented strict replay and atomic task binding.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent occurrence and task appends could orphan one side, while accepting a projected coordinate without revision-one evidence would erase durable scheduler provenance.
attempts.patch: Added persisted-to-materialized lifecycle replay and EventLog::append_pair over occurrence revision 1 and task NoStream, with typed conflict mapping and ADR-0050 authority documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found that validation hardcoded event_count 1 even when a malformed persisted event belonged to a two-event materialized history, and noted an avoidable expect in conflict mapping.
attempts.patch: Passed the actual replay event count through validation, added a two-event corruption assertion, pattern-matched the bound task ID without expect, reran verification, and obtained a no-actionable-comments exact-head review.

outcome.summary: The recurrence store now binds exact revision-observed occurrence provenance to caller-owned inert tasks atomically and replays both lifecycle states with strict typed evidence.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- record validate corpus/development/0176-atomic-recurrence-occurrence-materialization.json # result: valid development record
nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- corpus inspect corpus/development # result: inspected 177 records: 177 valid, 0 invalid

lessons: A materialization boundary should require durable coordinate evidence and its exact observed revision rather than accept an unpersisted projection.
Paired event-log append keeps occurrence provenance and caller-owned task creation atomic under collisions and concurrency.
Strict replay evidence must report the true durable history size even when validation fails while inspecting the first event.
Pattern matching an optional binding avoids an unnecessary panic path while preserving typed conflict distinctions.
Materialization records provenance only; catch-up selection, due policy, generated identity, dispatch, retry, and execution remain separate authorities.
